name: ReadMe
rows: Master CCVC denominator library for SIFP dashboard.
PSEC = Priority SIF Exposure Coverage. One PSEC row represents one SIF Exposure / protocol.
CCVC = Critical Control Verification Coverage. In this workbook, one Question equals one Critical Control / Critical Safeguard.
CCVC = YES / (YES + NO) x 100%. N/A is excluded from denominator.
Use Master_CCVC as lookup table for dashboard database / Power BI / Excel dashboard.
For actual observation, choose CLSR10A for Light Vehicle or CLSR10B for Heavy Equipment. Do not combine both denominators in one observation unless both protocols are verified.
Generated from SIFP Regional 4 protocol mapping discussion and accessible Google Drive protocol folder.
Current/latest reporting month conformance; source ANALYZE-TREND_ZONE latest month with Applicable > 0.
Cumulative YTD conformance across all observations; shown separately to avoid mixing with current-period dashboard card.
CLSR × Zona cumulative health map; status follows >=80% Effective, 50%-<80% Degraded, <50% Failed, blank denominator No Data.
Regional 4 Conformance Score = Total YES / (Total YES + Total NO) across OBS-001 to latest Obs_ID.
Monthly conformance is used only in ANALYZE-TREND_ZONE / Dashboard Section 6 and must not replace CONF.
CCVC denominator 77 is the critical safeguard coverage denominator and is independent from the total NO count used in conformance calculation.
